#en: Wind-scoured fields and broken irrigation lines make this place the perfect blind spot; no patrols, no curious neighbors, just ruined rows where a man like Dustback can finish what others only started. The abandoned farm still carries the memory of tainted trials and quiet cover-ups, the kind of ground he trusts more than any safehouse, because everyone who mattered here already walked away without ever understanding what they set in motion. Now he uses that neglect as shelter, tying off the last threads of his work where no one thinks to look. So far we have followed scattered data from a forgotten cache, half-scrubbed logs in a dead research site, and corporate whispers in a remote module, all pointing to the same freight hand who never really stopped working these fields.
zh: 被风刮蚀的田地与破损的灌溉线让这地方成为完美的盲点；没有巡逻队、没有好奇的邻居，只有一排排毁坏的垄沟——像"尘背"这样的人可以在那里完成别人只开了个头的事。那座废弃农场仍带着被污染试验与安静掩盖的记忆，那是他信任甚于任何安全屋的土地，因为这里每一个曾经要紧的人都已经离开，却从没弄明白自己启动了什么。如今他把这份荒废当作庇护，在没人想着去看的地方系紧自己工作的最后几根线。目前为止，我们追着零散数据从一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座死掉研究站里半擦除的日志，再到某个偏远舱室里的公司低语，全都指向同一名从未真正停止在这些田里干活的货运工。

#en: Ryujin Tower is where stories go to be rewritten in contract language, and somewhere deep in its labs is the first trace of how this one started to bend. The samples locked behind those glass doors are more than just experimental biomatter; they are patterned in the same strange way her jump trails are, quiet fingerprints of a pilot who keeps slipping between official narratives. Whatever she traded them for, it happened here, under security cams and non-disclosure clauses, long after the first rumor of a lost squadron began mutating in spacer bars. So far, all you really have are scattered bar talk about a Vanguard wing that never came home, a LIST convoy that got improbably lucky in bad space, and a name that keeps showing up on altered routes and corrupted insurance logs.
zh: 龙神大楼，是故事被用合同语言改写的地方，而在这栋楼实验室深处的某处，藏着这个故事最初如何开始弯折的第一道痕迹。锁在那些玻璃门后的样本不只是实验用生物质；它们的图案与她跃迁轨迹的奇怪方式如出一辙，是一名不断在官方叙述之间溜过的飞行员的安静指纹。无论她拿它们换了什么，交易都发生在这里，在安保摄像头与保密条款之下，远在"失踪中队"的第一则传闻开始在太空劫匪酒吧里变异之后。目前为止，你真正拥有的只有零散的酒吧闲谈——关于一支从未回家的先锋队飞行队、一支在糟糕空域里运气好得不像话的独立盟车队，以及一个不断出现在被改动航线与损坏保险日志上的名字。

#en:
Out here the relay clings to a dust-scoured moon, half-forgotten by the traffic it once watched, which is exactly why the broker chose it.  
Its isolation lets manifests drift off the official grid and into quieter ledgers, the kind smugglers and route-cutters trust more than any central archive.  
Anything tracing back to manipulated jumps and profitable wrecks would pass through a place like this, tucked into back rooms where conversations die to murmurs the moment a stranger steps in.  
The same hushed voices pointed you here: a found dataslate in the backcountry, a spooked crew on a small freighter who had seen the same accident pattern twice, then a relay-side fence who flinched at the name of a navigation analyst and hinted that some routes only exist in the margins.
zh:
在这里，那座中继紧紧贴着一颗被尘土刮蚀的卫星，被它曾注视过的交通半遗忘——这正是那位掮客选中它的原因。  
它的与世隔绝让舱单能漂离官方网格、进入更安静的账册，那种走私者与航线切割者信任甚于任何中央档案库的账册。  
凡是能追溯出"被操弄的跃迁与有利可图的残骸"的东西，都会经过这样的地方，藏在陌生人一进门谈话就降成呢喃的后室里。  
同样那些压低的声音把你指向这里：乡间一块捡到的数据板、一艘小货船上被吓坏的船员（他们两次见过同样的意外模式），然后是一名中继旁的销赃商——听到某位导航分析员的名字就一缩，并暗示某些航线只存在于页边。

#en: The research module is the kind of place procedures go to sleep: half-lit corridors, unattended consoles, maintenance drones still cycling through routines no one has monitored in years. Somewhere in the stacks, a misconfigured process has been quietly following off-pattern traffic, filing away jump data and cargo tags long after the project that created it was shut down and forgotten. If anything still remembers where her diversions really went, it is buried in those obsolete schedulers and half-archived logs. So far the trail is a string of neglected habits and lingering code: an outpost that kept logging the same ship twice, lab records that aligned with no official corridor, and a remote relay that continued recording phantom transits long after its operators walked away.
zh: 这座研究舱是那种程序会打瞌睡的地方：半亮的走廊、无人看管的控制台、仍在循环多年来无人监控例程的维护无人机。在某个资料堆里，一个配置错误的进程一直在悄悄跟踪非模式的交通，在一个创造它的项目早已被关停遗忘之后仍不断归档跃迁数据与货物标签。若说还有什么仍记得她的改道真正去了哪里，它就埋在这些过时的调度器与半归档日志里。目前为止，这条线索是一串被忽视的习惯与残留代码：一座把同一艘船记录两次的前哨、与任何官方走廊都对不上的实验室记录，以及一座在操作员离开很久后仍继续记录幽灵通行的远程中继。

#en: It has to be here, hung in the thin hush above an unremarkable world, where traffic is sparse and sensor noise is low enough that a single altered route can stand out like a scar across the sky. The ship holding position ahead, the VR-3488 Crossline, sits just off standardized lanes, anchored in a pocket of empty space no autopilot would choose. Whoever seeded this orbit knew how to hide in plain geometry, trusting that most captains would dismiss the stories as spacer gossip, misread beacons, or exaggerations from nervous haulers. You have already chased a discarded lead from a lonely rock and sifted the gutted logs of a silent courier; each fragment pointed to the same handwriting in the vectors, the same careful hand turning storms and empty space into shelter for one man.
zh: 必须在这里——悬在一颗平平无奇世界上方那片稀薄的静默中，那里交通稀疏、传感器噪声低到一条被改动的航线能像天空上一道伤疤那样显眼。前方保持位置的那艘船，"VR-3488 横线"，就停在标准航道外侧，锚定在一片任何自动驾驶都不会选择的空荡太空中。把这条轨道播下种子的人懂得如何在赤裸的几何里藏身，笃信多数船长会把那些故事当作太空劫匪的闲话、被误读的信标，或紧张货船船员的夸大。你已经追过一块来自孤独岩石的被丢弃线索，也筛过一艘沉默信使船被掏空的日志；每一块碎片都指向向量上同样的笔迹，同一只谨慎的手把风暴与空荡太空变成一个人的庇护所。

#en: The old relay bunker still hums under the dust, a leftover nerve ending from when the patrol grid actually mattered out here. Someone cut the staffing, locked the doors, walked away but never quite killed the systems; the scanners kept sweeping the sky on autopilot, quietly catching what no one was supposed to see. Buried in those half archived sweeps are the tracks of a ship that slipped through restricted airspace again and again, always on the same heading, moving like a man who knows where the blind spots are because he helped design them. So far the chase has turned up a forgotten dataslate on a nowhere rock and carved patterns in a gutted yard, both pointing to a salvage hand with old ties to UC lanes and a habit of treating every battlefield like it still belongs to him.
zh: 那座旧中继掩体仍在尘土下嗡鸣，是巡逻网格在这片区域还真正有意义时留下的一截神经末梢。有人裁掉了人员、锁上门走人，却从未真正关掉系统；扫描仪在自动驾驶下继续扫过天空，悄悄捕捉着没人该看到的东西。埋在那半归档的扫描记录里的，是一艘一次又一次溜过受限空域的船的轨迹，它总是同一航向，移动得像一个知道盲点在哪的人——因为他参与设计了那些盲点。目前为止，这场追查挖出了一穷乡岩石上被遗忘的数据板与被掏空场区里刻下的图案，两者都指向一名与联殖航道有旧交情、并且习惯把每一片战场都当成仍属于自己的打捞工。

#en: Neon's underbelly is where paper trails come to hide behind neon runoff and steam, where manifests are just as likely to be sold, forged, or buried as filed. If anyone is quietly routing ships through gaps in patrol coverage, their fingerprints will be down here in the rusted lockers and off-the-books ledgers the dock crews pretend not to see. The people who work these corridors live on looking away at the right time; whatever points to her paths will be tucked into that blind spot where fear of asking questions meets the need to get paid. So far the trail runs from that lonely frontier homestead to a broken beacon in high orbit, then to a derelict courier with its routes twisted just off standard lanes, each step tightening around the same pilot's invisible hand on the charts.
zh: 霓虹城的下腹，是纸面痕迹躲进霓虹污水与蒸汽后面的地方，舱单在那里被卖掉、伪造或埋葬的概率和归档一样大。若有人在悄悄把船只引过巡逻覆盖的空隙，他的指纹就会在下面这些锈蚀储物柜与码头工假装看不见的账外账册里。在这些走廊里讨生活的人，靠的就是在正确的时刻移开视线；任何指向她路径的东西，都会被塞进那个"怕问问题"与"需要拿到钱"相遇的盲点里。目前为止，线索从那座孤独的边境农庄，延伸到高轨道上一座损坏的信标，再到一艘航线被拧出标准航道外侧的弃置信使船，每一步都收紧着围绕同一名飞行员无形之手在星图上的位置。

#en: The Deserted Colony War Barracks is where the lie began to feel normal, a place built to process bodies until no one bothered to count them closely anymore. Walls that once echoed with triage calls now swallow the sound of bootsteps, and in that silence a medic who knew every corner could turn complacent record-keeping into a perfect blind spot. Here, among rusting bunks and faded casualty charts, she has been reworking histories for years, shuffling names between the living and the dead while Freestar and UC both looked away. The trail to this moment started with a forgotten dataslate in the dust, then a blood-stained tent outside Akila and a nervous clerk on Gagarin, finally circling through a buried UC relay where altered orders proved the pattern of carefully managed losses.
zh: 被遗弃的殖民地大战军营是谎言开始变得正常的地方，一座为处理躯体而建、直到再没人费心仔细清点的设施。曾经回响着分诊呼叫的墙壁，如今吞掉脚步声，而在那片寂静中，一名熟识每一个角落的医疗兵能把自满的记录习惯变成完美的盲点。在这里，在锈蚀的床铺与褪色的伤亡图表之间，她多年来一直在重编历史，把名字在生者与死者之间来回调换，而自由星系联盟与联殖都转开了视线。通往此刻的线索始于尘土中一块被遗忘的数据板，接着是阿基拉城外一顶血迹斑斑的帐篷与加加林星上一名紧张的文书，最后绕经一座被埋的联殖中继——在那里，被改动的命令证明了"精心管理的损失"这一模式。

#en: This backwater patch of ground is where the trail stops being theory and turns into stain. Whatever she tested here bled into the soil and air, a chemical fingerprint for the way she has been bending routes, contracts, and people without leaving neat records behind. Sampling it in place, surrounded by the same wind-scoured rock and forgotten equipment she used, is the only way to separate her work from all the other quiet poisons drifting through the Settled Systems. So far the picture is stitched from a half-corrupted log on a lonely outpost, a misaligned ping in high orbit, and a vault ship's inconsistent manifests, each fragment pointing in roughly the same direction while insisting on different details, as if everyone who touched this story remembered it just a little wrong.
zh: 这片穷乡之地，就是线索不再是理论、而变成污渍的地方。她在此测试的东西渗进了土壤与空气，成为一种化学指纹，标记着她一直在不留下整齐记录的情况下掰弯航线、合同与人。在实地取样，被同一片风蚀岩石与同一批她用过、被遗忘的设备环绕，是把她所做的一切与定居星系里其他所有安静毒物分开的唯一办法。目前为止，这幅图景是由一座孤独前哨上半损坏的日志、高轨道上一次错位的脉冲，以及一艘金库船前后不一致的舱单拼成的，每一块碎片都大致指向同一方向，却坚持不同的细节，仿佛每一个碰过这故事的人都记得它稍有偏差。

#en: HopeTown is where departures stop being stories on a LIST brochure and turn into stamped cargo, hull numbers, and fuel tallies, which means this is the only place the math of his vanishings might still be written down. Dock rats swear they remember a quiet pilot who always left on half-full tanks yet logged the same routes as everyone else, and old maintenance slates carry ghost entries that do not line up with the ships that actually left. Piecing it together from frayed manifests, half-wiped terminals, and a tired clerk's memory, the trail so far looks like this: an anonymous cache of nav data on a nowhere rock, a gutted relay whose logs were sliced into nonsense, and the same clean, uncanny jump profile repeating at every point where a colony's future simply fell off the map.
zh: 霍普镇，是离港不再只是独立盟宣传册上的故事、而变成盖了章的货物、船体编号与燃料统计的地方；这意味着，他那些人间蒸发背后的数学，也许还只在这里被写下来过。码头老鼠们发誓记得一名安静的飞行员，他总是带着半满的燃料箱离开，却登记着和所有人一样的航线；而旧的维护数据板带着与实际离港船只对不上的幽灵条目。用磨损的舱单、被擦掉一半的终端与一名疲惫文书的记忆拼凑，目前为止这条线索是这样的：某块鸟不拉屎岩石上一处匿名的导航数据储藏点、一座日志被切成胡言乱语的被掏空中继，以及同一个干净而诡异的跃迁剖面——它在一座殖民地未来从星图上掉落下去的每一个点上反复出现。

#en: This place is the only ground that makes sense for her to stand on. The Abandoned Deimos Scrapyard is everything she ever believed in and everything she was thrown away with, stacked into canyons of dead steel and half-born hulls. Here she can erase evidence with a torch stroke, cut loose any ship that might betray her, and vanish her ghost fleet back into the bones of the system if given a few more hours. The truth behind all of it feels simple enough to touch and yet slippery in the details: a wreckwright proving how fragile the lanes are. We traced the pattern from a forgotten dataslate in a backwater shed, to a silenced listening post where her maintenance tags were scrubbed, to a drifting Trade Authority support hulk wired with her weld signatures and falsified cargo trails.
zh: 这地方是她唯一站得住脚的地面。"废弃火卫二废料场"就是她曾信仰的一切，也是她曾与之一同被丢弃的一切，堆成一座座死钢与半成形船壳的峡谷。在这里，她能以一记喷枪抹掉证据，割断任何可能背叛她的船，若再多给她几个小时，还能把她的幽灵舰队化回这套系统的骨骼里。这一切背后的真相简单得仿佛触手可及，细节上却又滑不留手：一名残骸工匠在证明这些航道有多脆弱。我们追着这个模式，从穷乡棚屋里一块被遗忘的数据板，到一座她维护标签被擦净的被噤声听音哨，再到一具漂着的贸易管理局支援船壳——上面接满了她的焊接签名与伪造的货运轨迹。

#en: Out here, the relay husk still hums with ghost signals, its dishes frozen mid-swing toward a sky Vector has been quietly reshaping for years. This is one of his blind corners, a shell on the ground that anchors the misaligned constellations overhead, where he can rewrite flight paths, mute storm warnings, and route whatever the Master Archive is about to broadcast. If he finishes severing or retuning these channels, every settlement that ever trusted the sky will be flying on lies for good. Back on the fringe station, at that forgotten listening post, even the techs who showed me corrupted insurance logs and odd storm telemetry looked away when his callsign appeared. On the vault ship, GalBank records, LIST pings, and sensor contracts all bent toward the same quiet hand in orbit.
zh: 在这里，那座中继残壳仍因幽灵信号而嗡鸣，它的天线盘冻结在摆向中途，朝向一片"向量"多年来一直在悄悄重塑的天空。这是他的一处盲角，一个地面上的壳，锚定着头顶那些错位的星群；在这里，他能改写飞行路径、让风暴警告静音，并安排"主档案库"即将广播的任何内容。若他完成对这些信道的切断或重调，每一个曾信任天空的定居点都将永远飞在谎言之上。回到边境星际站、在那座被遗忘的听音哨里，连那些给我看损坏保险日志与古怪风暴遥测的技师，在他的呼号出现时都移开了目光。在那艘金库船上，盖尔银行记录、独立盟脉冲与传感器合同，全都弯向轨道上同一只安静的手。

#en: It had to end here, under the dripping conduits and humming grav trains, because this is where it started to go wrong for her. The queues outside the LIST office, the families sleeping on metal benches, the quiet bribes and desperate eyes all pressed Grid into the shape she finally chose; this warren of stairwells and service tunnels is the cradle of her anger and the market for her lies. From here she can disappear into crowds, erase herself in a dozen overlapping data trails, or slip one final batch of doctored approvals into the system before some new frontier dies for it. The pattern of dead applications, the poisoned farmstead, the broker in Neon, and the derelict cutter in deep orbit all point the same way now, back to the depths where she first learned how to bend the grid.
zh: 它必须在这里终结——在滴水的导管与嗡鸣的引力列车之下，因为这里正是她开始走错的地方。独立盟办公室外的长队、睡在金属长椅上的家庭、安静的贿赂与绝望的眼神，把"网格"压成了她最终选择的形状；这片楼梯井与维修隧道构成的迷宫，是她愤怒的摇篮，也是她谎言的市场。从这里，她能消失进人群，在十几条重叠的数据痕迹里抹掉自己，或在某片新边境因此死掉之前，把最后一批做过手脚的批准溜进系统。死掉的申请、被下毒的农庄、霓虹城的掮客，以及深空轨道上那艘弃置切割船的模式，如今都指向同一个方向——回到她最初学会如何掰弯这张网格的深处。

#en: Out here with the GB-3498 Stockwind tumbling in silent orbit, there is no PR officer, no broker, no claims adjuster to polish the numbers; only frozen corridors and abandoned cargo holds where the real balances were kept. GalBank will swear this loss was random misfortune on a certified corridor, but the way the hull is holed, the way emergency beacons were never armed, says somebody modeled the odds and stacked them. Somewhere in this dead ship are the ledgers and route amendments that tie a quiet navigator to calculated disasters and carefully timed payouts. Back in Gagarin I heard captains whisper about unlicensed lanes that all bent the same way, and every story about Vector since has circled the same pattern of low-risk routes that somehow only ever fail for the right clients.
zh: 在这里，"GB-3498 存风"在寂静轨道上翻滚，没有公关专员、没有掮客、没有理赔员去粉饰那些数字；只有冻结的走廊与被弃的货舱——真正的账目就存在那里。盖尔银行会发誓说这次损失是认证航道上的随机不幸，可船壳被破开的方式、应急信标从未被激活的方式，都说明有人计算过概率并做了局。在这艘死船里的某处，藏着那些把一名安静的领航员与精心算计的灾难、时机精准的赔付系在一起的账册与航线修订。回到加加林星，我听到船长们低声议论那些全都朝同一方向弯折的无证航道，而此后每一个关于"向量"的故事，都绕着同一种低风险航线模式——它们不知怎地只会"恰好"坑害正确的客户。

#en: The remote research module clings to the dark like it wants to be forgotten, yet its racks still hum with archived traffic the corporations swore they never kept. This is where side channels bled into black budgets, where quiet analysts fed routing experiments to clients who did not want their fingerprints on the math. Whatever was pulled from the chain here bent an entire relay network off true, and buried inside those records is the inflection point that turns rumor into a heading. Every tech, clerk, and broker who whispered about the ghost in the charts swears they heard it from someone else: a scorched dataslate on a derelict outpost, a scrubbed relay spewing ghost vectors, a nervous contact hinting that UC claims and Ecliptic payouts kept crossing the same name in the margins.
zh: 那座偏远研究舱紧贴着黑暗，像希望被人遗忘，可它的机架仍在嗡鸣着公司发誓从未保存过的归档交通。这里正是侧信道渗进黑预算的地方，是安静的分析员把航线实验喂给不愿在数学上留指纹的客户的地方。凡是从这里的链上被拉走的东西，都把整张中继网掰离了真实；而在那些记录里埋着的，是那个把传闻变成航向的拐点。每一个低声议论"星图中的幽灵"的技师、文书与掮客，都发誓自己是从别人那里听来的：一座弃置前哨上烧焦的数据板、一座喷吐幽灵向量的被擦净中继、一名紧张的线人暗示联殖索赔与黄道佣兵团的赔付不断在页边撞上同一个名字。

#en: Out on the plant perimeter, the air hums with stripped conduits and aging compressors, every pipe and silo still tuned to the same Helium-3 flows that once made entire colonies rise or fall on a spreadsheet. If anyone wanted to rewrite those numbers at the source, to bend extraction yields and shipping manifests beyond audit, it would have to be here, in the blind spot where ore becomes collateral and no one checks twice. Whatever Luc Schmit is about to do, this place lets it echo through ledgers from Narion to Cheyenne before anyone can agree what really happened. All we know for certain is a forgotten data-slate in the dust, odd discrepancies buried in Gagarin contracts, and a silent vault ship that should have been empty but carried echoes of the Credit Ghost instead of closure.
zh: 在工厂外围，空气因被剥光的导管与老化的压缩机而嗡鸣，每一根管道与料仓仍调校到同样的氦-3 流量——它们曾让整片殖民地在电子表格上崛起或崩塌。若有人想从源头改写那些数字，把开采产量与航运舱单掰到审计之外，那就必须在这里，在这个"矿石变成抵押品、没人会复核两遍"的盲点。无论吕克·施密特打算做什么，这地方能让它从纳里昂星到夏延星的账册里一路回响，赶在任何人就"究竟发生了什么"达成一致之前。我们能确定的只有：尘土里一块被遗忘的数据板、加加林星合同里埋着的古怪不符，以及一艘本该空无一物、却载着"信贷幽灵"回声而非了结的沉默金库船。

#en: Whichever way you tilt the sensors, this patch of orbit keeps sliding between stable solutions, a mathematical crossroads where two grav routes brush against each other without ever quite touching; it is exactly the kind of place a former stress analyst would use to hide a decision point in his models. The data out here was never meant for traffic control or survey charts, only for someone who knows how to read the split between safe lane and soft spot, and every hushed story you have heard in bars and backrooms treats this region like a name best not spoken too loudly. Up to now the trail has been a doctored accident report in a quiet lab, a cast-off slate of frantic equations, and a New Atlantis paper trail that suggests his work was quietly pushed off-world rather than corrected.
zh: 无论你把传感器朝哪边倾斜，这片轨道都在几个稳定解之间滑动，一处数学上的十字路口，两条引力路线在此相擦却从不真正接触；这正是前应力分析员会用来在模型里藏一个决策点的地方。这里的资料从来不是为交通管制或勘探星图准备的，只属于某个懂得如何解读"安全航道与软点之间那条缝"的人；而你在酒吧与密室里听过的每一个低声故事，都把这片区域当成一个最好别太大声说出的名字。到目前为止，这条线索是某间安静实验室里一份被做手脚的事故报告、一块写满狂乱方程的废弃数据板，以及一条新亚特兰蒂斯城的纸面痕迹——它暗示他的工作是被悄悄推出了行星之外，而不是被纠正。

#en: Out here on an unremarkable rock, the wind does most of the erasing. Sensor masts lean, soil scarred where someone set up more than a simple survey, then broke it down in a hurry. Whatever they were feeding into the local biosphere started in makeshift labs like this, far from auditors and after-action reports, where samples could be tested on quiet ground and any mistakes buried under dust and time. No one logged what was really mixed or released; all that remains is residue in the dirt and a few mismatched inventory tags. So far the trail has jumped from that abandoned frontier homestead with its unnatural calm, to the drifting beacon in orbit, to a courier whose routes were bent off the books, every step hinting at experiments tested in the dark and then scrubbed from the record.
zh: 在这块平平无奇的岩石上，风做了大部分的擦除工作。传感器桅杆歪斜，土壤上留着伤痕——有人在此架设的不只是简单的勘探，然后匆忙拆除。他们喂给本地生物圈的东西始于这样的临时实验室，远离审计员与行动后报告；在这里，样本能在安静的地面上被测试，任何错误都能被尘土与时间埋掉。没人记录究竟混合或释放了什么；留下的只有泥土里的残留物与几枚对不上的库存标签。目前为止，这条线索从那座"平静得不自然"的废弃边境农庄，跳到轨道上漂着的信标，再到一艘航线被拧出账册的信使船，每一步都暗示着在黑暗中被测试、随后从记录里被抹掉的实验。

#en: Nobody trusts what comes through this relay anymore, which is exactly why it matters. The place is dead on paper, yet its dishes still track passing hulls a little too closely, and rumor says someone rewired its heart to listen for cargo that is supposed to be gone. Lost Legion took it over quietly, like they were babysitting a story they do not want spreading: ex-soldiers watching an abandoned node no one officially maintains, waiting for patterns only they recognize. So far the trail is all whispers and half-logs: a misfiled ping on a lonely rock, corrupted records from a research station that never logged a distress call, and dockhands back in civilized space swearing they heard a tug's signature twice on the same approach while their supervisors insisted they were imagining things.
zh: 已经没人相信经过这座中继的东西了，而这正是它要紧的原因。这地方在纸面上是死的，可它的天线盘仍在把过往船体贴得稍微太近地追踪；传闻说，有人重接了它的心脏，专门监听那些"本该已经消失"的货物。失落军团悄悄接管了它，像在照看一则他们不愿扩散的故事：一群老兵看守着一个无人正式维护的废弃节点，等待只有他们认得的模式。目前为止，这条线索全是低语与半截日志：孤独岩石上一次归档错误的脉冲、一座从未记录过遇险呼叫的研究站里损坏的记录，以及文明星域里码头工发誓他们同一次进近听到了同一艘拖船的签名两次——而他们的主管坚称他们在胡思乱想。

#en: Out here, the planet is just a cold disc below and the real traffic runs along invisible lines, where one altered signal can nudge thousands of lives a fraction off course. This orbiting node matters because it sits dead center in that tangle, a quiet splice where sanctioned routes and someone else's corrections overlap. The freighter standing guard is no accident either; years of captains taking slightly faster paths, brokers shaving risk margins, and one navigator rewriting tolerances have all converged on this anonymous hull and the data it shields. So far, the trail has led from a buried cache of corrupted nav work on a forgotten world to a shaken colonist's testimony about a torn-apart convoy near an old homestead, each fragment pointing to the same hand quietly bending the lanes.
zh: 在这里，行星只是下方一枚冰冷的圆盘，真正的交通沿看不见的线运行——在那里，一个被改动的信号就能把成千上万条命推偏一点点。这座轨道节点之所以要紧，是因为它坐落在那团乱麻的正中央，一处"获批航线"与"别人的修正"重叠的安静接点。那艘负责警戒的货船也绝非偶然；多年船长抄稍快的路径、掮客削风险边际，以及一名领航员改写容差，全都汇聚到这具无名的船壳与它所保护的数据上。目前为止，这条线索从一颗被遗忘世界上被埋的损坏导航数据储藏点，延伸到一名受惊定居者关于某座老农场附近一支被撕碎车队的证词，每一块碎片都指向同一只悄悄掰弯航道的手。

#en: Gagarin's rusted gantries and humming server stacks are exactly where someone would hide the paperwork for stolen weather, buried among freight schedules and corporate maintenance chatter no one ever audits. The same off-world firms that gutted this place now rent floor after floor of storage and processing, a perfect blind for quietly shunting atmospheric data and shipment records through machines nobody claims to own. Whatever passes through here changes hands without leaving fingerprints, and the locals have learned which questions not to ask, which file names not to say aloud. So far the trail runs from a forgotten prefab, to a dead hunter's fractured report, to crop yields that defy their own forecasts; each stop adds another layer to the pattern she has been drawing across the sky.
zh: 加加林星锈蚀的龙门架与嗡鸣的服务器机柜，正是有人会藏"被盗天气"文书的地方——埋在从未被审计的货运日程与公司维护闲聊里。那些曾把这地方掏空的太空公司，如今一层接一层地租下存储与处理空间，一个完美的掩护，可以悄悄把大气数据与货运记录转经没人承认自己拥有的机器。凡是经过这里的东西都易手而不留指纹，当地人也学会了哪些问题不该问、哪些文件名不该念出声。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的预制房，到一名死掉猎人的零碎报告，再到违背自身预报的作物产量；每一站都为她在天空上画出的那个模式又添了一层。
